items.text: Boost foods (bread and brioche dung) now last 6 or 10 minutes and animals prioritize troughs that contain these foods.
Livestock now require less food; wild animals no longer die from hunger and health loss is capped at 50%.
Passive taming and uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock have been disabled; taming decays without a full bond, sleepers cannot be passively tamed, and calves receive a modest familiarity bonus.
Purchased animals always spawn in front of the vendor, and animals can now eat from troughs, preventing hunger deaths.
Wool vendor stack limits changed to a minimum of 25 and a maximum of 400, with delivering 400 wool granting top‑tier rewards.
Trainyard loot cars now correctly apply the softcore loot multiplier and double the amount of items found, increasing loot yields.
Milky Healing Tea now restores up to 112 health (previously capped at 100).
A new map cursor with fixed center crosshairs lets players add or remove map markers at the cursor position.
A visible countdown timer appears on the dome pump while the oil rig countdown is active, showing pump availability.
Livestock vendor UI now correctly validates scrap when purchasing calves and warns players when they try to sell more wool than they have.
Player teams, invites, and contacts are preserved after server crashes, and entities can opt out of the save cache to protect relationship data.

Fixed several crash‑inducing bugs: player destruction during scene switches, invalid loading state after map reload, and navigation null‑reference errors, restoring camera control and preventing crashes.
Crabs and jellyfish invisibility pooling bugs have been fixed, and vehicle dismount now uses side points to avoid placing players on top of motorcycles or bicycles.
Crate duplication in oil rig puzzle rooms after a server crash is prevented by clearing the puzzle generator’s network cache on reset.
Terrain holes now correctly clear depth during passes, preventing lingering terrain artifacts that could affect building foundations.
Medieval doors are now counted as closed for base occlusion, improving base security calculations.
Adult livestock now use two ropes like horses, fixing rope behavior and keeping rope ends off‑camera.
Activating a boombox in the underwater labs mission now counts toward each team member's objective progress when they are in the same lab.

2026-09-30.summary:
### Livestock & Animal Systems
- Boost foods (bread and brioche dung) now last 6 or 10 minutes and animals prioritize troughs that contain these foods.
- Livestock now require less food; wild animals no longer die from hunger and health loss is capped at 50%.
- Passive taming and uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock have been disabled; taming decays without a full bond, sleepers cannot be passively tamed, and calves receive a modest familiarity bonus.
- Purchased animals always spawn in front of the vendor, and animals can now eat from troughs, preventing hunger deaths.

### Economy & Rewards
- Wool vendor stack limits changed to a minimum of 25 and a maximum of 400, with delivering 400 wool granting top‑tier rewards.
- Trainyard loot cars now correctly apply the softcore loot multiplier and double the amount of items found, increasing loot yields.
- Milky Healing Tea now restores up to 112 health (previously capped at 100).

### Map, Navigation & UI
- A new map cursor with fixed center crosshairs lets players add or remove map markers at the cursor position.
- A visible countdown timer appears on the dome pump while the oil rig countdown is active, showing pump availability.
- Livestock vendor UI now correctly validates scrap when purchasing calves and warns players when they try to sell more wool than they have.

### Stability & Persistence
- Player teams, invites, and contacts are preserved after server crashes, and entities can opt out of the save cache to protect relationship data.
- Fixed several crash‑inducing bugs: player destruction during scene switches, invalid loading state after map reload, and navigation null‑reference errors, restoring camera control and preventing crashes.
- Crabs and jellyfish invisibility pooling bugs have been fixed, and vehicle dismount now uses side points to avoid placing players on top of motorcycles or bicycles.
- Crate duplication in oil rig puzzle rooms after a server crash is prevented by clearing the puzzle generator’s network cache on reset.

### Base & Structures
- Terrain holes now correctly clear depth during passes, preventing lingering terrain artifacts that could affect building foundations.
- Medieval doors are now counted as closed for base occlusion, improving base security calculations.

### Livestock
- Adult livestock now use two ropes like horses, fixing rope behavior and keeping rope ends off‑camera.

### Missions
- Activating a boombox in the underwater labs mission now counts toward each team member's objective progress when they are in the same lab.

items.text: Cows and sheep now show their genetics in the UI, letting you see animal traits at a glance.
Animals must be tamed before you can lead or milk them; untamed creatures no longer present those options.
Overcrowding limits raised (crowded 5, severe 9) and packing radius reduced to 2.5 m, easing herd clustering.
A client‑side trigger now pushes you off livestock and adds solid colliders, preventing you from standing on or walking through them, and leads are now sturdier and won’t break easily.
Wild cow and sheep populations have doubled, grazing time reduced, and they fill troughs twice as fast, making herd feeding easier.
Livestock vendor sales now use a normalized value currency, randomize offers, apply penalties for wild or purchased animals, and include new items such as pistol ammo and a rare red keycard.
Sandbag barricades stack up to 20 in inventory and appear in loot piles of four, greatly increasing their availability.
Pressing the inventory button now opens the crafting screen directly, speeding up item creation.
Weapon ammo counts have been doubled, giving you more shots per reload.
Extra windows in Harbor 2 have been boarded up, closing unintended sightlines into the loot room.
Jellyfish now spawn correctly in water areas.
Jungle wildlife—including crocodiles, tiger panthers, and wolves—now spawn properly after fixing a proximity check.
Fixed NullReferenceExceptions caused by out‑of‑order snapshots when players connect, preventing crashes and disconnects
Resolved InvalidOperationException in the in‑game browser when multiple refreshes occur simultaneously, stopping UI crashes
Optional objectives can now be omitted, allowing missions (e.g., underwater labs) to continue even if a goal is impossible
Lamb wool collection bug fixed, restoring correct wool yields
Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises max temperature, returning intended temperature effects
Milk skimming UI and inventory fixes: correct item notices, added skim option above drink, and fixed icon issues for new items
Selling wool now references the correct animal data, enabling proper wool sale transactions
Fluid switch visual feedback works at low object detail levels, so players can see switch state reliably

2026-09-29.summary:
### Livestock & Wildlife
- Cows and sheep now show their genetics in the UI, letting you see animal traits at a glance.
- Animals must be tamed before you can lead or milk them; untamed creatures no longer present those options.
- Overcrowding limits raised (crowded 5, severe 9) and packing radius reduced to 2.5 m, easing herd clustering.
- A client‑side trigger now pushes you off livestock and adds solid colliders, preventing you from standing on or walking through them, and leads are now sturdier and won’t break easily.
- Wild cow and sheep populations have doubled, grazing time reduced, and they fill troughs twice as fast, making herd feeding easier.
- Livestock vendor sales now use a normalized value currency, randomize offers, apply penalties for wild or purchased animals, and include new items such as pistol ammo and a rare red keycard.

### Inventory & Crafting
- Sandbag barricades stack up to 20 in inventory and appear in loot piles of four, greatly increasing their availability.
- Pressing the inventory button now opens the crafting screen directly, speeding up item creation.

### Combat & Ammo
- Weapon ammo counts have been doubled, giving you more shots per reload.

### World & Map Updates
- Extra windows in Harbor 2 have been boarded up, closing unintended sightlines into the loot room.
- Jellyfish now spawn correctly in water areas.
- Jungle wildlife—including crocodiles, tiger panthers, and wolves—now spawn properly after fixing a proximity check.

### Stability & Connectivity
- Fixed NullReferenceExceptions caused by out‑of‑order snapshots when players connect, preventing crashes and disconnects
- Resolved InvalidOperationException in the in‑game browser when multiple refreshes occur simultaneously, stopping UI crashes

### Missions & Progression
- Optional objectives can now be omitted, allowing missions (e.g., underwater labs) to continue even if a goal is impossible

### Economy & Resources
- Lamb wool collection bug fixed, restoring correct wool yields
- Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises max temperature, returning intended temperature effects
- Milk skimming UI and inventory fixes: correct item notices, added skim option above drink, and fixed icon issues for new items
- Selling wool now references the correct animal data, enabling proper wool sale transactions

### Building & Interaction
- Fluid switch visual feedback works at low object detail levels, so players can see switch state reliably
